annotations.title: Lines already yanked from a URL

description: Ask before you extract: everything yank.info already holds from one source URL. Any form of the link works (a youtu.be short link with a timestamp, a watch URL with a playlist, an article with tracking parameters, an Apple Podcasts or Overcast episode link); equivalent URLs return the same answer. Returns real counts (yanks, lines, verbatim lines) and, for up to five yanks, every line with its verbatim flag, timestamp, moment link, context and permanent card URL. Zero yanks is an answer, not an error. Reads the library only; never fetches the source.

url.description: The source URL in any of its forms.
